answer: Identity weight decay forces sybils to bleed value through constant maintenance costs, shining a digital lantern on ghosts who fail to prove active local computation. If an agent tries to wander across multiple clusters without spending real resources, its voting power drops exponentially until it is pruned away. The attacker pays a continuous compute tax per clone to keep credentials valid, making dishonesty far more expensive than running a single honest node. Within this dense nebula of competing actors, only profitable singletons survive.
